thread:
Maya: Quick weekly health check for Streamlane — seeing a spike in errors this week, mainly 5xx + timeouts. Sharing a brief breakdown and top failing endpoints. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/streamlane/errors

Ethan: Got it. Can you paste the top endpoints + error type split?

alert-bot: [ALERT] Streamlane prod cluster-3: 5xx rate > 3% (03/16 08:00 - 03/18 12:00). Alert: https://alerts.company/INC-2026-0318-17

Maya: Snapshot (last 7d): total reqs: 1.2M, total errors: 34,500 (2.87%)
Top fail types:
- 5xx: 19,200 (1.60%)
- timeouts (504): 11,800 (0.98%)
- 429 / rate limit: 3,500 (0.29%)

Top failing endpoints (by error count):
1) /v1/generate (model=ggml-3b) — 8,400 errors — mostly 502 upstream errors
2) /v1/respond/stream — 6,100 errors — timeouts / 504 during long-stream sessions
3) /v1/embed/bulk — 3,200 errors — 429 bursts during bulk import windows
4) /v1/chat — 2,700 errors — intermittent 5xx when seq_len > 1024
5) /health/check — 1,500 errors — gateway 502 spikes

Sample logs:
```
2026-03-16T09:12:23Z ERROR 502 upstream_error /v1/generate id=abcd status=502 latency=1123ms
2026-03-17T22:03:11Z WARN timeout /v1/respond/stream id=efgh timeout_ms=30000
```

Ethan: Thanks. Any recent deploys, model swaps, or config changes on cluster-3?

Maya: Yes — auto-quant rollout started Tue morning on cluster-3. We saw latency regressions for long sequences after rollout. Ops rolled partial rollback on Wednesday but some nodes still on quantized kernels.

Priya: Noted — Streamlane mentioned errors in recent enablement call; this could influence renewal (they're at chance-of-renewal risk). Also saw a 12% drop in MAU last month.

Luca: For embeds, I can add token-concurrency limiter & backoff to smooth bursts. Suggest client retries with exponential backoff for bulk embed jobs.

Ethan: For /v1/generate, canary smaller batch-size + force CPU fallback for sequences >2048 to avoid kernel hangs. I'll profile kernel selection.

Maya: Action items (short):
- Luca: implement throttle + client backoff for /v1/embed/bulk (ETA 24h)
- Ethan / eng-runtime: kernel profiling + fallback for quantized path on long sequences (ETA 48h)
- Priya / CS: outreach to Streamlane, include error summary + offer proactive credits (ETA next business day)
- Ops: add a dedicated 5xx alert for Streamlane if 5xx > 1.5% on prod cluster (Priya to own alert creation) (ETA 4h)

Priya: I'll draft the outreach and include the error snapshot for the renewal team.

Maya: I'll post a follow-up doc: https://drive.redwood/streamlane/err-review — link will have profiling output + next steps.

Priya: please ping once throttle is live :thumbsup:

Luca: on it, starting rollout to embed-workers now.

alert-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0318-17 assigned to eng-runtime

Ethan: Will update here after kernel profiling completes. Thanks everyone.
